title: 第22章 羡慕？想学？我教你啊
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “流动红旗到~三班长兼新训一排排长周凯东，接旗！”走廊上，陆阳鼻孔塞着纸团子，脖领子和胸前的军装上还有几块褐色斑点。只见他双手托举“内务卫生”流动红旗，迈着四方步，如同钦差大臣一般被人前呼后拥的往班上走。孔垄掐着嗓子，像宫里的内务府大总管似的，还没回到宿舍里就已经叫唤起来。然后，他就挨了周凯东一脑瓜子：“学特么什么不好，学太监，要死啊你！”孔垄捂着脑袋，牙花子直吸溜：“疼疼疼疼！”玩归玩，闹归闹，对于这面流动红旗周凯东还是很在意的。尽管，三班已经有一面了，但荣誉这东西谁会嫌多？“没打输吧？”“哪儿能啊，赢了！”虽然陆阳鼻孔塞着纸团，下巴上还沾着血，看着格外滑稽。但却昂着头，脸上的表情格外自豪。像是带着整个班，干了一件特别了不起的大事似的。周凯东笑着他从陆阳手里接过流动红旗，挂在了先前“作风纪律”流动红旗旁边。就这一下子，两面流动红旗全部挂在了三班。这种感觉很是奇妙，以往大家都觉得，荣誉这种东西是看不见摸不着的。可当他们废了老鼻子劲，才从四班把红旗抢回来后，莫名觉得浑身舒爽，像是刚做完一套推拿按摩。“班长，你是不知道啊，四班长简直就是个无赖，堵在门口不让我们进去！”“明明连长都下了命令了，我们还把你给搬出来，人家愣是不鸟我们，我们只能硬闯！”“班副都被一拳干出鼻血了，那帮家伙简直欺人太甚，然后我们就他娘的跟他拼了......”得胜归来的新兵们，一个个兴高采烈的吹嘘着先前的战斗多么激烈，他们是如何英勇。周凯东听得是满脸笑意，他知道去拿旗的过程不会那么顺利，因为没有人愿意把自已好不容易获得的荣誉拱手相让。尽管，这是四班好不容易才投机取巧得来的，那也不能改变荣誉本身的价值。从流动红旗上头的褶皱，以及少掉的部分黄色流苏，不难想象先前的争夺有多激烈。先前光是在底下听到楼板震动，还有楼上的叫骂声，他就几次想要上去帮忙，但都被克制住了。因为这是锻炼班级凝聚力，和集体荣誉感的最佳时机。部队里，提倡良性竞争，反感没由头的闹情绪闹矛盾。如果是为了争夺荣誉而产生的冲突，上面都会睁一只眼闭一只眼。先前，连长明明可以逼着四班长把流动红旗交出来，给到周凯东以后再离开，这样就能避免冲突发生。但他偏偏没这么干，这就是连长的带兵之道。当兵，需要血性！更需要为了集体荣誉冲冠一怒的勇气！或许，在经历这件事之前，新兵蛋子们会把流动红旗当做一种可有可无的东西。但在经历过这次事情后，至少四班和三班新兵会深刻意识到，荣誉两个字对于军人和集体的影响有多大。......“战斗”虽然已经结束，但此刻三班新兵依旧显得很亢奋，仿佛有使不完的力气。他们中绝大多数从来没打过架的，尽管这顶多算小摩擦，并不能称之为真正的冲突。但肢体上的暴力接触，以及陆阳喷洒出的鼻血，已经足够让他们所有人肾上腺素飙升，热血沸腾。而在先前的冲突里，最有种的就是陆阳，那样的身板都敢顶到最前面，简直是勇气的典范。其次便是孔垄，这家伙块头大，是攻门夺旗的中坚力量，更是不可撼动的基石。但要说表现最突出的，最亮眼的，还得是丁腾飞。要不是他冲上去一脚踹翻了门口的两个新兵，他们也没法取得关键性突破，一拥而上的冲进去，将那面象征胜利的旗帜给顺利带回来。“咦，奇怪，丁腾飞人呢？”“先前还看到的，怎么人不见了？”“班副也不见了？”正当众人疑惑之际，周凯东咳嗽一声，将他们的注意力拉了过来。并宣布，这周午休恢复正常，早上也会给大家多睡十分钟。“耶！”三班新兵异常兴奋。天气越来越冷，起床也变得格外困难。能躲在被窝里赖上一分钟，对于他们来说就是幸福的。更何况，这个幸福更是他们亲手争取回来的，能不高兴吗？周凯东压了压手：“只要流动红旗，还挂在咱们三班一天，新训期间你们就能一直享受这个待遇。”“只要你们好好表现，周末可以适当的给大家放松，发放除手机以外的电子产品。”“要是想家了，就拿班长手机给家里打个电话，电话费我出。”新兵们更加激动了，没想到只是小小的两面流动红旗，却像是得到了金手指一般，能带来这么多好处？难怪部队里争这东西争的这么凶，难怪四班长和他们班新兵宁愿耍无赖都不肯撒手！“既然大家这么高兴，那我再来讲点儿更更高兴的！”“好好好！”“抽查背诵《条令条例》和《军人保密守则》，背不出来的午休取消！”“？？？？？”新兵们瞬间被泼了盆冰水，笑容僵在脸上。这尼玛部队套路也太深了！刚宣布奖励，现在就要取消，这不等于啥也没捞着吗？周凯东不给他们反应机会，直接开始点名：“孔垄，条令条例第二条，背！”孔垄像是踩了电闸一般，浑身抖如筛糠，脑袋一片空白：“额，额，第二天是.......”周凯东破口大骂：“背特么多少天了，到现在记不住，长脑子了吗？滚过去抄二十遍！”紧跟着，他就把魔爪伸向了瑟瑟发抖的下一个新兵。.......水房里，自来水龙头哗啦啦的开着。丁腾飞正埋头趴在水池边，一遍遍的漱口。每次吐出来的水都是粉红色的，唾沫里还带着血丝。先前的冲突里，他冲的最猛干的最凶，吸引的火力自然也是最大。不仅胳膊肘和肩膀火辣辣的疼，舌头也被咬破了，连带着一颗牙都有些许松动。“谢了，刚才。”丁腾飞扭过头，看到身后站着的陆阳，什么也没说，只是自顾自的继续漱口。反倒是陆阳走过来，关心了一句：“没事吧，要不要去医务室看看？”丁腾飞擦擦嘴，拧上龙头：“不用，没那个必要。”陆阳从口袋里摸出烟，却发现烟盒早已变了形，连带着里头的几根香烟都被拧成了麻花。但他还是精挑细选了一根还算能看的，递过去：“来一根？”丁腾飞显得很诧异：“你居然有烟，还特么是一盒？”陆阳耸耸肩：“很稀奇吗？”“你藏哪儿的？”“柜子里。”“不可能！”丁腾飞根本不信：“连长他们才突击检查过，要是你放柜子里，怎么可能没被逮到？”陆阳见他不伸手，干脆叼在自已嘴上，抬手遮住风用火机点着。一个大回龙，榨干了这一口的所有价值，这才把烟吐出。动作熟练的像个老烟鬼，看的丁腾飞这个精神小伙一愣又一愣的。陆阳夹着烟，淡定的看着丁腾飞：“人，真的很难想象认知以外的事儿。”“这包烟是班长给的，我就放在柜子里，但突击检查那会我却一点儿事儿没有。”“先前指导员把我单独喊出去，就是为了把烟和火机还给我，还告诉我下不为例。”看着丁腾飞那副见了鬼的震惊模样，陆阳笑了笑：“是不是很不可思议？”是！丁腾飞认知都被打破了。这在他看来，这是根本就不可能的事。因为当初他就是因为偷偷抽烟，被班长提*干。后来犯了错，也没有任何一个人保他，反而被关了整整两天的禁闭室。可为什么，自已踩过的雷到了陆阳这一个都没爆开？反而他还敢这么明目张胆的揣着烟盒，在水房里抽烟？陆阳：“其实，我也觉得很不可思议，但事实就是如此，你踩过的雷到了我这，全成了哑雷。”丁腾飞：“你给他们好处了？还是认识什么部队里的大人物？”陆阳摇头：“我一普通家庭，可能吗？”丁腾飞觉得陆阳在说谎，他的认知经历告诉他。陆阳一定是在背后搞了什么小动作，否则不可能出现这样的事。这才认识多久，如果没有利益，谁会愿意帮你？但下一秒，他就被再度刷新了三观，二班长正巧提着两个水壶进来接热水。丁腾飞原以为陆阳明目张胆的在这抽烟，马上就要挨喷挨骂。却没想到，二班长看到陆阳抽烟后的第一反应却是。“这烟都折成这样了，还抽？”“来来来，二班长这里有好烟，抽我的。”“陆阳，你小子是真可以啊，没有班长带着都敢去四班找茬，还把四班长给踹了。有胆识，我喜欢，哈哈哈哈！”看着二班长提着水壶笑呵呵的离开，以及陆阳手里多出的那根云烟，丁腾飞感觉三观都要震碎了。这算什么？这特么算什么？老子之前的那些罪都特么白挨了？这帮狗日的怎么还玩儿双标，怎么还看人下菜碟啊？“羡慕吗，想学吗？”陆阳摇摇手指：“我教你啊，保你新训三个月顺顺利利，平平安安。”
content_en: "The moving red flag is here~ Zhou Kaidong, the third squad leader and the newly trained platoon leader, take the flag!" In the corridor, Lu Yang had paper dumplings stuffed in his nostrils, and there were a few brown spots on his neck collar and the military uniform on his chest.I saw him holding the mobile red flag of "Internal Hygiene" in both hands, walking in a square step, and walking to the class like an imperial minister, being cheered and supported by others.Kong Long pinched his throat, like the chief steward of the palace's internal affairs department, and was already shouting before he returned to the dormitory.Then, he slapped Zhou Kaidong in the head: "What the hell is wrong with studying? If you learn to be a eunuch, you will die!" Kong Long covered his head and sucked: "It hurts, it hurts!" After playing and making trouble, Zhou Kaidong still cared about this moving red flag.Although Class Three already has one side, who can have too much honor?"You didn't lose, did you?" "No way, you won!" Although Lu Yang had paper balls stuffed in his nostrils and blood on his chin, he looked particularly funny.But he held his head high, with a particularly proud expression on his face.It was as if he had led the entire class to do something extraordinary.Zhou Kaidong smiled as he took the mobile red flag from Lu Yang and hung it next to the previous "style and discipline" mobile red flag.At this moment, two mobile red flags were all hung in class three.This feeling is very wonderful. In the past, everyone thought that honor was invisible and intangible.But when they used up their old nose strength and snatched the red flag back from the fourth class, they felt inexplicably refreshed, as if they had just finished a massage."Squad leader, you don't know. The fourth squad leader is a scoundrel, blocking the door and not letting us in!" "Obviously the company commander gave the order, but we moved you out, but they didn't tolerate us, so we had to force our way in!" "The squad vice-presidents allI got a nosebleed from a punch, those guys bullied me too much, and then we just fucking fought with them..." The new recruits who returned from victory happily boasted about how fierce the previous battle was and how brave they were.Zhou Kaidong listened with a smile on his face. He knew that the process of getting the flag would not be smooth, because no one was willing to give up the honor they had finally won.Even though Class 4 was able to obtain it through hard work and opportunism, it does not change the value of the honor itself.From the wrinkles on the flowing red flag and the missing part of the yellow tassel, it is not difficult to imagine how fierce the previous competition was.Previously, he only heard the shaking of the floor below and the yelling from upstairs. He wanted to go up to help several times, but was restrained.Because this is the best time to exercise class cohesion and collective sense of honor.In the army, healthy competition is encouraged and unprovoked emotions and conflicts are resented.If there is a conflict over the fight for honor, the higher-ups will turn a blind eye.Previously, the company commander could have forced the fourth squad leader to hand over the mobile red flag and give it to Zhou Kaidong before leaving, thus avoiding conflicts.But he didn't do that. This is how a company commander leads troops.Being a soldier requires blood!What’s more needed is the courage to be angry for the sake of collective honor!Perhaps, before experiencing this, the new recruits would regard the mobile red flag as a dispensable thing.But after experiencing this incident, at least the recruits in Class 4 and Class 3 will be deeply aware of how much influence the word honor has on soldiers and the collective....Although the "battle" has ended, the recruits in the third class are still very excited at this moment, as if they have endless strength.Most of them have never fought before, although this is a minor friction at best and cannot be called a real conflict.But the violent physical contact and the nosebleed sprayed by Lu Yang were enough to make everyone's adrenaline surge and their blood boil.In the previous conflicts, the most classy person was Lu Yang. With such a body, he dared to go to the front, which was simply a model of courage.Next is Kong Long. This guy is big and is the backbone of attacking the goal and capturing the flag. He is also the unshakable cornerstone.But the one who performed the most outstandingly and stood out the most was Ding Tengfei.If he hadn't rushed up and kicked the two recruits at the door, they wouldn't have been able to make a critical breakthrough, rush in and bring back the flag symbolizing victory smoothly."Hey, it's strange, where is Ding Tengfei?" "I saw him before, but why is he missing?" "The shift deputy is also missing?" Just as everyone was wondering, Zhou Kaidong coughed and drew their attention.He also announced that lunch breaks will return to normal this week and everyone will be given an extra ten minutes of sleep in the morning."Yeah!" The recruits from the third class were extremely excited.The weather is getting colder and getting out of bed has become extra difficult.Being able to hide in bed for a minute is happiness for them.What's more, they fought for this happiness with their own hands, how can they not be happy?Zhou Kaidong pressed his hand: "As long as the mobile red flag remains hanging in our third class for one day, you can always enjoy this treatment during the new training period." "As long as you behave well, you can relax properly on weekends and distribute electronic products other than mobile phones." "If you feel homesick, use the squad leader's mobile phone to call home, and I will pay for the phone bill." The recruits were even more excited. They didn't expect that it was just two small mobile red flags, but it was like getting a golden finger, and it could bring so many benefits?No wonder there is such fierce competition for this thing in the army. No wonder the fourth squad leader and his new recruits would rather play rogue than let go!"Since everyone is so happy, let me tell you something even happier!" "Okay, okay!" "Spot checks on reciting the "Documents and Regulations" and the "Code of Military Secrecy". If you can't memorize it, the lunch break will be cancelled!" "????" The recruits were instantly poured ice water, and the smiles froze on their faces.This ridiculous army routine is too deep!The rewards have just been announced and are now being cancelled. Doesn’t this mean that nothing has been gained?Zhou Kaidong didn't give them a chance to respond, and directly started to roll call: "Kong Long, Article 2 of the Order and Regulations, memorize it!" Kong Long seemed to have stepped on a switch, his whole body was shaking like chaff, and his head went blank: "Uh, uh, the next day is..." Zhou Kaidong cursed: "I have been memorizing it for how many days, and I can't remember it now. Have I got a brain? Go over and copy it twenty times!" Immediately afterwards, he extended his claws to the next shivering recruit...... In the water room, the tap was running loudly.Ding Tengfei was lying by the pool, rinsing his mouth over and over again.Every time I spit out the water, it is pink, and there is blood in the saliva.In the previous conflicts, he charged the hardest and fucked the most ferociously, so he naturally attracted the most firepower.Not only did his elbows and shoulders hurt, but his tongue was bitten and even one of his teeth was slightly loose."Thank you, just now." Ding Tengfei turned his head and saw Lu Yang standing behind him. He didn't say anything and just continued to rinse his mouth.Instead, Lu Yang came over and asked with concern: "Are you okay? Do you want to go to the infirmary?" Ding Tengfei wiped his mouth and turned on the faucet: "No, it's not necessary." Lu Yang took out a cigarette from his pocket, only to find that the cigarette case had been deformed, and the few cigarettes inside had been twisted into twists.But he still carefully selected one that was still readable, and handed it over: "Want one?" Ding Tengfei looked very surprised: "You actually have cigarettes, and a pack of them?" Lu Yang shrugged: "Is it strange?" "Where did you hide it?" "Cabinet""Impossible!"Ding Tengfei didn't believe it at all: "The company commander and the others just conducted a surprise inspection. How could you not have been caught if you put it in the cabinet?"Seeing that he didn't reach out, he simply put it in his mouth, raised his hand to cover the wind and lit it with a lighter.A giant dragon squeezed out all the value of this mouthful before spitting out the smoke.His movements were as skillful as those of an old smoker, and Ding Tengfei, a spirited young man, was stunned again and again.Lu Yang held the cigarette and looked at Ding Tengfei calmly: "It's really hard for people to imagine things other than cognition." "This pack of cigarettes was given to me by the monitor, and I put it in the cabinet, but nothing happened to me during the surprise inspection." "The instructor called me out alone before, just to return the cigarettes and lighter to me, and told me not to do the same next time." Looking at Ding Tengfei's shocked look of seeing a ghost, Lu Yang smiled: "Isn't it incredible?" Yes!Ding Tengfei's cognition was shattered.In his opinion, this is simply impossible.Because he was raped by the squad leader because he secretly smoked.Later, he made a mistake and no one protected him. Instead, he was put in a solitary cell for two full days.But why didn't any of the thunders he stepped on explode when it came to Lu Yang?Instead, he dared to blatantly carry a cigarette case and smoke in the water room?Lu Yang: "Actually, I also find it incredible, but that's the truth. The thunder you stepped on became dumb when it came to me." Ding Tengfei: "Did you give them benefits? Or do you know some big shot in the army?" Lu Yang shook his head: "I am from an ordinary family, is it possible?" Ding Tengfei felt that Lu Yang was lying, and his cognitive experience told him.Lu Yang must have done something behind his back, otherwise such a thing would not have happened.How long have you known each other? If there is no benefit, who would be willing to help you?But the next second, his outlook was refreshed again. The second squad leader happened to come in with two kettles to get hot water.Ding Tengfei originally thought that Lu Yang would be sprayed and scolded for smoking here blatantly.Unexpectedly, the second squad leader's first reaction after seeing Lu Yang smoking was."This cigarette has been folded like this, and you still smoke it?" "Come on, second squad leader, there are good cigarettes here, smoke mine." "Lu Yang, you are really good. Without the squad leader, you dared to go to the fourth squad to find trouble, and even kicked the fourth squad leader. You are courageous, I like it, hahahaha!" Seeing the second squad leader leaving with a smile and carrying the kettle, and the extra Yunyan in Lu Yang's hand, Ding Tengfei felt that his outlook was shattered.What is this?What the hell is this?All the sins I committed before were all in vain?Why do these idiots still play double standards and wait and see who gets the food?"Are you envious? Do you want to learn?" Lu Yang shook his finger: "I'll teach you. I'll make sure your new training goes smoothly and safely for three months."
